description: Parmigiana di Melanzane is a classic Italian vegetarian dish, a symphony of tender fried eggplant slices layered with rich tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella, and savory Parmesan cheese. Baked to golden perfection, this comforting casserole offers a delightful blend of textures and authentic Mediterranean flavors. It is a true taste of Italy perfect for any occasion.

instructions.title: Prepare Eggplant
instructions.text: Slice eggplants into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Generously sprinkle them with salt and let them sit in a colander for about 30 minutes to draw out bitterness and excess water. Pat them thoroughly dry with paper towels before frying.

instructions.title: Fry Eggplant Slices
instructions.text: Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet or frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the eggplant slices in batches until they are golden brown and tender on both sides. Transfer the fried eggplant to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.

instructions.title: Make the Tomato Sauce
instructions.text: In a separate pot, heat a splash of olive oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour in the crushed tomatoes, stir in the chopped fresh basil, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Simmer the sauce for 15-20 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.

instructions.title: Assemble the Parmigiana Layers
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange a single layer of fried eggplant slices over the sauce. Top with a layer of sliced or shredded mozzarella cheese, a sprinkle of grated Parmesan, and a spoonful of tomato sauce. Repeat these layers until all ingredients are used.

instructions.title: Bake to Perfection
instructions.text: Finish the top layer with a generous amount of tomato sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese. If using, lightly brush the top with the beaten egg for an extra golden crust. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown.

instructions.title: Rest and Serve
instructions.text: Once baked, remove the Parmigiana di Melanzane from the oven and let it rest for at least 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving. This crucial resting period allows the layers to set properly, ensuring cleaner slices and a more integrated flavor experience. Serve warm.

tips: To reduce excess oil, after frying, gently press the eggplant slices between layers of paper towels to absorb any remaining oil.
For a richer and more authentic flavor, always opt for high-quality San Marzano tomatoes for your sauce.
Allowing the Parmigiana to rest for 10-15 minutes after baking is crucial. This helps the layers set and prevents it from falling apart when served.
